en-US.description: Convert WordPerfect documents, DataPerfect databases, and WordPerfect Notebooks locally.
en-US.longDescription:
A modern Windows desktop application for converting WordPerfect documents to modern formats,
and for exporting DataPerfect databases and WordPerfect Notebooks to CSV, Excel, and SQLite.
Features include batch processing, recursive folder scanning, multiple output formats (DOCX, PDF, RTF, TXT, ODT, CSV, XLSX, SQLite),
and 100% local processing, your files never leave your computer. LibreOffice is bundled with the installer,
so no additional software is required.
en-US.name: WPD Converter
